item.title: Cabinet Hardware CH-001
item.description:
Model CH-001 - Cabinet Hardware

Product Overview

Modern cabinet handle/knob for kitchen and bathroom cabinets with stylish design.

Key Features

  • Contemporary design
  • Durable construction
  • Comfortable grip
  • Easy to clean
  • Multiple finishes

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Model Number CH-001
Material Zinc Alloy / Aluminum / Stainless Steel
Surface Finish Chrome / Brushed / Matte Black
Hole Spacing 32mm / 64mm / 96mm / 128mm
Projection 25-35mm
Weight 50-150g per piece

Why Choose This Cabinet Hardware CH-001?

  • Premium Zinc Alloy / Aluminum / Stainless Steel Construction — Made from selected zinc alloy / aluminum / stainless steel, ensuring long service life even in demanding environments.
  • Versatile Finish Options — Available in chrome / brushed / matte black to match any architectural style and preference.
  • Wide Application Range — Perfectly suited for kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, providing reliable performance.
  • Factory Direct Pricing — As an ISO 9001 certified manufacturer, we offer competitive pricing without middlemen markup.
  • Quality Assurance — Each piece undergoes 100% inspection before packaging. Salt spray tested for corrosion resistance.

Shipping & Packaging Details

All products are professionally packaged for export. Standard export carton with individual bubble wrap protection. FOB Yiwu / Shanghai port. Sample orders dispatched within 3-5 days via international express (DHL/FedEx/UPS). Bulk orders shipped within 15-25 days by sea.
